questions.question: Select the option that is related to the Third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term. 10 : 30 :: 68 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Four brothers P, Q, R and S go to a hotel. They book four hotel rooms numbered 301, 302, 303 and 304. Sum of room numbers of P and R is 603 and the sum of room numbers of R and S is 604. What is the sum of room numbers of P, Q and R?
questions.solution:
Brothers- P, Q, R and S.

Hotel rooms numbered- 301, 302, 303 and 304.

Sum of room numbers of P and R is 603. This means room number 301 and 302 is booked by P and R, not necessarily in the same order.

The sum of room numbers of R and S is 604. This means room number 301 and 303 is booked by R and S, not necessarily in the same order.

From the above statements, it is clear that R booked room number 301, P booked room number 302 and S booked room number 303.

Therefore, room booked by Q is 304.

Sum of room numbers booked by P, Q and R = 302 + 304 + 301 = 907

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true. even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements:**

Some shirts are socks.

No sock is red.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some socks are shirts.

II. No shirt is red.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The diagram are given bellow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/983f3ec95200a0477e20489670e7df6ef5a62bafe24211e3f8f0bebecf2e1bec.png] 

I. Some socks are shirts.→ True 

II. No shirt is red. → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question: If PT is written as 8-10, how will NLR be written?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79d4908b834bf54d7ec2d257a8956438c92ddbb5313b38c1a3e419d711ee0041.png] 

If PT is written as 8-10 that means place value of P = 16 is divided by 2 we get first value = 8 and place value of T = 20 is divided by 2 we get second value = 10.

P = 16/2 = 8

T = 20/2 = 10

Similarly, NLR is written as 

Place value of N = 14 is divided by 2 we get first value = 7, place value of L = 12 is divided by 2 we get second value = 6 and place value of R = 18 is divided by 2 we get third value = 9.

NLR is written as 7-6-9.

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace * signs and to balance the given equation:

530 * 2 * 3 * 5 * 800
questions.solution:
Option 1 :530 ÷ 2 + 3 - 5 = 800

Applying BODMAS rule

265 + 3 - 5 = 800

263 = 800

This is wrong.

Option 2 : 530 ÷ 2 - 3 - 5 = 800

265 -8 = 800

258 = 800

This is also wrong.

Option 3 : 530 ÷ 2 × 3 + 5 = 800

265 × 3 + 5 = 800

795 + 5 = 800

800 = 800

This is correct.

Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
